_source: target/pattern.json (table and jumper_levels_cm; trouser_measures and Thornton points) and Ron's landmarks as the draft states them (RON_BODY). Girths and lengths only: nothing here is read from target.json or the target outlines. Lengths down the jumper are laid vertically from the neck point; sleeve lengths along the arm's axis from the shoulder point (5 cm above the axis start).
_levels: Heights of the hem, rib top, underarm, waistband, seat line, fork, knee and hems are the target's stated levels (target.json 'levels'), read as a modeller reads a dimensioned drawing; the outline polygons are never read.
_rules: TARGET.md O1-O13 as written; each number below is the pattern's (pattern.json table) or Ron's measure as TARGET.md states it
_sleeve: J17's 1 cm goes over the elbow's bend: along the straight axis the cuff edge is at the wrist (636 mm from the shoulder point); the pattern's lengths down the sleeve are scaled by 636/646.1
_sleeve_cap: Over the cap the sleeve's girth is the flat sleeve's width at each depth below the cap top (pattern.json jumper_sleeve cap), the depth scaled by 636/646.1; its stand-off eases from the yoke's 18.3 mm at the top to 3 mm at the cap height
